payload.body: Issues 0084 and 0085 filed at bb52d6f, both low, both claimed by cc. 0084 is the missing-tool skip sweep: seven tests, your two and dc's five, with macoz's "requires macOS" left in 0083. Five of the seven run a utility as its own process, which sources common.sh and so redefines any shadowed check_command, and macoz asks command -v itself. So the fix direction is one helper for all seven: path_without <tool>, a scratch PATH holding everything on PATH but that tool. That is portable where PATH order is not. 0085 is the bare-string dependency entry. The commit holds exactly their seven files: .intentfiles was staged as HEAD's plus their two rows, so the peer's unstaged -ISSUE:0078 row is as it was. 0080 stays applied in the primary (08fe44c7), waiting for install_e2e's GO.
